info.title: Rikkaus Wealth OS API
info.description: Versioned REST contract for the Rikkaus Wealth OS backend. Errors follow RFC 9457 with a urn:rikkaus:problem: type.

servers.description: Relative to the deployment's own base URL

get.summary: Read the reporting currency and the declared USD/VND rate
get.description: Returns VND as the fixed reporting currency together with the rate the user declared, the date they declared it effective, and when the server stored that declaration. The three rate fields are null until a rate has been declared; that is the rate-needed state, not an error.

200.description: The settings of the signed-in user

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

406.description: The requested media type cannot be produced

put.description: Stores the rate and the date the user says it took effect, and stamps the server's own record of when it was stored. The effective date must not be in the future; it is judged as a Vietnamese civil date, not a UTC one.

400.description: The rate is missing or not positive, or the effective date is missing or in the future

errors.message: must not be in the future

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

415.description: The request body is not JSON

get.description: Returns the signed-in user's identifier, their verified Google email, and the display name they chose — or the Google one if they never changed it.

200.description: The profile of the signed-in user

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

406.description: The requested media type cannot be produced

put.description: Stores the name the user chose. It is kept apart from the name Google reports, so a later sign-in refreshes the Google value without reverting this one. The email is not editable: it comes from the verified identity token.

400.description: The display name is blank or longer than 120 characters

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

415.description: The request body is not JSON

get.description: Returns the liability when the signed-in user owns it. An identifier belonging to another user answers not-found with the same body a missing identifier produces.

put.description: Replaces every field except the category, which is chosen once when the liability is created. An omitted optional field is cleared, because this is a replacement rather than a patch: omitting collateralAssetId unlinks the collateral. The same rules as creation apply, and the collateral is re-checked against the signed-in user.

200.description: The liability as it now stands

400.description: A required field is missing, an amount is negative or too precise, a recurring payment is not positive or is half-stated, a date is inconsistent, or the collateral is not an asset the signed-in user owns

delete.description: Deletes the liability when the signed-in user owns it. A plain removal; undo and a retention policy belong to issue #104. A second delete of the same identifier answers not-found, the same answer any unknown identifier gets. Two deletes that overlap give one 204 and not-found to the rest rather than a server error. The pledged asset, if any, is untouched.

400.description: The identifier in the path is not a UUID

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

404.description: No such liability, it belongs to another user, or a concurrent request removed it first

A second delete of the same identifier answers not-found, the same answer any unknown identifier gets. Two deletes that overlap, which is what a double-tapped confirm button produces, give one 204 and not-found to the rest rather than a server error.

A second delete of the same identifier answers not-found, so the response is not idempotent and that is deliberate: it is the same answer any unknown identifier gets. Two deletes that overlap, which is what a double-tapped confirm button produces, give one 204 and not-found to the rest rather than a server error.

An empty catalog is an empty array and a 200, not a 404. Amounts are reported in each liability's own currency; converting a USD balance to VND is the client's, using the rate from GET /api/v1/settings/exchange-rate.

post.summary: Add a liability to the catalog
post.description: Creates a liability owned by the signed-in user. Terms and schedule are recorded as stated and nothing is computed from them. The maturity date must not be before the start date, the next payment date must fall inside the term when the term is given, the recurring amount and frequency come as a pair, and a collateral must be an asset the signed-in user owns.

400.description: A required field is missing, an amount is negative or too precise, a recurring payment is not positive or is half-stated, a date is inconsistent, or the collateral is not an asset the signed-in user owns. An unrecognised category, currency or frequency is a malformed-request instead, because the body cannot be parsed.

get.description: Returns every goal the viewer owns, nearest target date first and then by name. An empty list is an empty array and a 200, not a 404. Every amount is in VND. No projection is included: completion, remaining amount, remaining time, required contribution and status arrive with issue #89.

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

post.description: Creates a goal owned by the signed-in user from any of the seven templates. The target amount must be greater than zero, the allocated amount may not exceed it, and the target date must be after today as a Vietnamese civil date. The expected return is the user's own assumption, 0 to 30 percent, and is informational only.

400.description: A required field is missing, an amount is negative, zero where it must be positive or too precise, the allocated amount exceeds the target, the return is outside 0 to 30, or the target date is not after today. An unrecognised type is a malformed-request instead, because the body cannot be parsed.

get.summary: List the signed-in user's cash-flow entries
get.description: Returns every income and expense entry the viewer owns, newest effective date first and then newest created first. An empty catalog is an empty array and a 200, not a 404. Amounts are reported in each entry's own currency; converting a USD entry to VND is the client's, using the rate from GET /api/v1/settings/exchange-rate. A recurring entry is one row, not one row per month: expansion is issue #74.

a monthly salary, a quarterly tuition fe.description: a monthly salary, a quarterly tuition fee and a one-time USD dividend

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

406.description: The requested media type cannot be produced

post.description: Creates an income or expense entry owned by the signed-in user. The category must belong to the entry type. A one-time entry has an effective date and nothing else; a recurring one has a start date, a recurrence and an optional end date. Dates may be in the future: an expected entry is a legitimate one. An entry may link to one of the viewer's assets or one of their liabilities, never both; a linked record that is not the viewer's, or that does not exist, is refused with the same message either way.

400.description: A required field is missing, the amount is not positive or too precise, the category does not belong to the entry type, the recurrence or end date does not fit the timing, the end date precedes the effective date, a linked asset or liability is not the viewer's, or both links are sent together. Every problem is reported at once in the errors array. An unrecognised constant is a malformed-request instead, because the body cannot be parsed.

post.description: Exchanges a refresh token for a new access token and a new refresh token. The presented token is single-use: presenting it again is treated as evidence that it leaked and revokes the whole session.

400.description: The refresh token is missing from the body

401.description: The refresh token is unknown, expired, already used, or revoked

415.description: The request body is not JSON

post.description: Revokes the session the refresh token belongs to. Returns 204 whether or not the token was still live, so the endpoint cannot be used to test whether a token is valid.

204.description: The session is no longer usable

400.description: The refresh token is missing from the body

415.description: The request body is not JSON

post.summary: Complete a Google sign-in and start a session
post.description: Exchanges an authorization code with Google using PKCE, creates the account on first sign-in, and returns an access token with a rotating refresh token. Google is the only identity provider; there is no password.

An empty catalog is an empty array and a 200, not a 404. Values are reported in each asset's own currency; converting a USD holding to VND is the client's, using the rate from GET /api/v1/settings/exchange-rate.

post.summary: Add an asset to the catalog
post.description: Creates an asset owned by the signed-in user, and the first record of its valuation history with the same value, currency, date and optional rate snapshot. All prices are manually entered; there is no market-price integration in MVP 1A. The valuation date must not be in the future and a purchase date must not be later than it, both judged as Vietnamese civil dates. A later value is recorded through POST /api/v1/assets/{assetId}/valuations, never by editing this one.

400.description: A required field is missing, a value is negative or too precise, a quantity is not positive, a date is impossible, or the rate snapshot is incomplete or given for a VND asset. An unrecognised category, currency or liquidity is a malformed-request instead, because the body cannot be parsed.

get.description: Returns every valuation ever recorded for the asset, newest first: latest effective date, and between two records on one date the later recorded. Exactly one record is marked current, and it is the one the asset's currentValue, currency and valuationDate are taken from. Values are in the asset's own currency with the rate the user applied; converting to VND is the client's. An asset always has at least one record, written when it was created.

post.description: Appends a record to the asset's history. Nothing already recorded changes. When the new record's effective date is on or after the current record's, the asset's currentValue, currency and valuationDate become this record's in the same transaction and the response marks it current; a record dated earlier is kept as history and marks nothing. Two records on one date are a correction and its original, and the later recorded is current. To correct an earlier record, send its identifier in correctsValuationId with the reason in note; the original stays readable. The currency must be the asset's. A USD record may carry the USD/VND rate the user applied and its date, both or neither; a VND record carries neither.

get.description: Returns the seven onboarding steps in backbone order, each done or not according to the user's own records at this moment, together with the step the user last viewed and whether they completed or dismissed the flow. A user who has recorded no progress reads as step 1, in progress; reading never creates progress.

patch.summary: Record progress through the guided onboarding
patch.description: Records any of: the step the user is viewing, that they reviewed their first dashboard, and that they completed, dismissed or reopened the flow. Members left out or null are unchanged; an empty body changes nothing and returns the checklist. Whether the other six steps are done cannot be written: it is read from the user's records.

ProblemDetail.description: RFC 9457 problem details. Returned for every error under /api/v1/**.

type.description: Stable taxonomy identifier. A URN rather than a URL because the project owns no domain; RFC 9457 does not require it to dereference.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation, safe to display. Never contains a stack trace, an internal class name or a credential.

instance.description: The request URI the problem occurred for.

correlationId.description: Extension member. The same value as the X-Correlation-Id response header and the server's log lines for this request.

errors.description: Extension member, present on validation failures only. One entry per rejected field.

GoalRequest.description: Create or replace a goal. The same fields for every template.

name.description: What the user calls this goal.

type.description: Which of the seven templates this goal follows. Editable.

targetAmount.description: The amount to reach, in VND. Must be greater than zero.

currentAllocatedAmount.description: What has already been set aside for this goal, in VND. Zero or more, and never above the target amount. Omit for nothing set aside yet, which is stored as 0.00.

targetDate.description: The date to reach the goal by. When created, or when changed, it must be after today as a Vietnamese civil date; keeping a stored date is always allowed.

plannedMonthlyContribution.description: What the user plans to add each month, in VND. Zero or more. Omit when not stated; that is kept distinct from zero.

expectedAnnualReturnPercent.description: The user's own assumption for the annual return, in percent, from 0 to 30. Omit for no assumption. Informational only; never a promise.

name.description: What the user calls this goal.

type.description: Which of the seven templates this goal follows.

currency.description: The currency every amount is in. Always VND.

currentAllocatedAmount.description: What has been set aside so far. 0.00 when nothing yet.

targetDate.description: The date to reach the goal by.

plannedMonthlyContribution.description: Planned monthly contribution. Null when not stated.

expectedAnnualReturnPercent.description: The user's assumed annual return in percent. Null when no assumption.

createdAt.description: When the server first stored this goal.

updatedAt.description: When the server last stored a change to it.

CashFlowEntryRequest.description: Create or replace a cash-flow entry. The same body serves both.

entryType.description: Whether the money comes in or goes out. Decides the sign; the amount is always positive.

category.description: One of the seven income or nine expense categories. Must belong to the entry type given.

amount.description: The amount, in this entry's currency. Greater than zero.

currency.description: The currency the amount is expressed in. No conversion is stored; the client converts with the rate from the settings resource.

timing.description: ONE_TIME or RECURRING. Decides whether recurrence and endDate may be present.

recurrence.description: How often a recurring entry repeats. Required when timing is RECURRING and must be omitted when it is ONE_TIME.

effectiveDate.description: The date a one-time entry applies, or the first date of a recurring one. May be in the future.

endDate.description: The last date a recurring entry applies. Only for RECURRING; omit for open-ended. Must not be before effectiveDate.

linkedAssetId.description: An asset of the signed-in user this entry refers to, such as the apartment a rent comes from. Omit to leave it unlinked, or to clear it on PUT.

linkedLiabilityId.description: A liability of the signed-in user this entry refers to, such as the mortgage an interest payment belongs to. Must not be sent together with linkedAssetId. Omit to leave it unlinked, or to clear it on PUT.

notes.description: Anything the user wants to remember about it. Omit to clear it on PUT.

CashFlowEntryResponse.description: A cash-flow entry in the signed-in user's catalog.

category.description: One of the sixteen categories, always of the entry's type.

amount.description: The amount, in the entry's own currency. Always positive.

currency.description: The currency the amount is expressed in.

recurrence.description: MONTHLY, QUARTERLY or YEARLY for a recurring entry. Null for a one-time one.

effectiveDate.description: The date a one-time entry applies, or the first date of a recurring one.

endDate.description: The last date a recurring entry applies. Null when open-ended or one-time.

linkedAssetId.description: The user's asset this entry refers to. Null when unlinked.

linkedLiabilityId.description: The user's liability this entry refers to. Null when unlinked.

notes.description: The user's own note. Null when not recorded.

createdAt.description: When the server first stored this entry.

updatedAt.description: When the server last stored a change to it.

UpdateAssetMetadataRequest.description: Replace an asset's editable metadata. The valuation is not editable here.

name.description: What the user calls this asset.

liquidity.description: How readily the user judges this asset can be turned into cash.

purchaseDate.description: When the asset was acquired. Must not be in the future and must not be later than the asset's stored valuation date. Omit to clear it.

quantity.description: Units held. Must be greater than zero when present. Omit to clear it.

institution.description: Where the asset is held or stored. Omit to clear it.

AssetResponse.description: An asset in the signed-in user's catalog.

name.description: What the user calls this asset.

category.description: One of the eleven asset categories.

currentValue.description: What the asset is worth, in its own currency: the value of the current record in its valuation history.

currency.description: The currency the values are expressed in.

valuationDate.description: The date the user states the value was accurate: the effective date of the current valuation record.

liquidity.description: How readily the user judges it can be turned into cash.

purchaseValue.description: Purchase value or cost basis. Null when not recorded.

purchaseDate.description: When the asset was acquired. Null when not recorded.

quantity.description: Units held. Null when not recorded.

institution.description: Where it is held or stored. Null when not recorded.

notes.description: The user's own note. Null when not recorded.
notes.example: Tiền gửi dự phòng bằng USD.

createdAt.description: When the server first stored this asset.

updatedAt.description: When the server last stored a change to it.

CreateLiabilityRequest.description: Create a liability. The category is chosen here and cannot be changed later.

name.description: What the user calls this liability.

category.description: One of the six liability categories.

outstandingBalance.description: What is still owed, in this liability's currency, as the user states it. Zero is allowed, negative is not.

currency.description: The currency the balance and the recurring payment are expressed in. No conversion happens here; the client holds the declared rate.

interestRate.description: Nominal annual interest rate in percent, as the user states it: 8.5 means 8.5 % per year. Recorded only; nothing accrues from it.

maturityDate.description: When it is due to be settled. Must not be before the start date.

recurringPaymentAmount.description: The total due each period, in the liability's currency. Must be greater than zero, and must come with a frequency.

recurringPaymentFrequency.description: How often the recurring payment falls due. Must come with an amount.

nextPaymentDate.description: The next date a payment is due. Must fall between the start and maturity dates when those are given. May be in the past.

collateralAssetId.description: The asset pledged against this liability. Must identify an asset the signed-in user owns; any other identifier is refused with the field named.

notes.description: Anything the user wants to remember about it.
notes.example: Thế chấp căn hộ Thảo Điền.

RefreshSessionRequest.description: Carries the refresh token identifying the session to renew or end.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token returned by the most recent sign-in or renewal.

SessionResponse.description: A signed-in session: an access token, its lifetime, and the refresh token.

accessToken.description: Signed JWT to send as `Authorization: Bearer`.

expiresInSeconds.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

refreshToken.description: Single-use token for renewing the session. Rotated on every renewal.

GoogleSignInRequest.description: Completes a Google sign-in started by the client.

authorizationCode.description: The authorization code Google returned to the client's redirect URI.

codeVerifier.description: The PKCE code verifier for the challenge sent when the flow started.

redirectUri.description: The redirect URI used to obtain the code. Must appear in the server's allowlist.

CreateAssetRequest.description: Create an asset with the fields every category shares.

name.description: What the user calls this asset.

category.description: One of the eleven asset categories.

currentValue.description: What the asset is worth, in this asset's currency. Entered by the user; there is no price feed. Zero is allowed, negative is not.

currency.description: The currency the values are expressed in. The reporting currency is separately fixed to VND and is read from the settings resource.

valuationDate.description: The date the user states this value was accurate. Must not be in the future, judged as a Vietnamese civil date.

usdToVndRate.description: The USD/VND rate the user applied to currentValue, kept with the first record of the valuation history as the rate used. Only for a USD asset, and only together with rateEffectiveDate.

rateEffectiveDate.description: The date the user states that rate took effect. Must not be in the future. Only together with usdToVndRate.

liquidity.description: How readily the user judges this asset can be turned into cash.

purchaseValue.description: Purchase value or cost basis, in the same currency.

purchaseDate.description: When the asset was acquired. Must not be in the future and must not be later than the valuation date.

quantity.description: Units held, where that is meaningful. Must be greater than zero.

institution.description: Where the asset is held or stored.

notes.description: Anything the user wants to remember about it.
notes.example: Tiền gửi dự phòng bằng USD.

RecordValuationRequest.description: Record what an asset is worth. Appended to the history; the asset's current value follows when this is the newest record.

value.description: What the asset is worth, in the asset's own currency. The original amount, never a converted one. Zero is allowed, negative is not.

currency.description: The currency of the value. Must be the asset's currency.

effectiveDate.description: The date the user states this value was true. Must not be in the future and not before the asset's purchase date, judged as a Vietnamese civil date. Decides whether this record becomes the current one.

usdToVndRate.description: The USD/VND rate the user applied to this value: a snapshot kept with the record, not a reference to the settings rate. Only on a USD record, and only together with rateEffectiveDate.

rateEffectiveDate.description: The date the user states that rate took effect. Must not be in the future. Only together with usdToVndRate.

note.description: Why this record exists. Required when correcting an earlier record; otherwise optional.
note.example: Cập nhật số dư sau khi đối chiếu sao kê.

correctsValuationId.description: The earlier record of this asset that this one corrects. The original is kept unchanged and stays readable; this record carries the reason in note.

AssetValuationResponse.description: One record in an asset's valuation history.

assetId.description: The asset this record belongs to.

value.description: What the asset was worth, in its own currency.

effectiveDate.description: The date the user states the value was true.

usdToVndRate.description: The USD/VND rate the user applied when recording this value. Null on a VND record, and null when the user did not capture it.

rateEffectiveDate.description: The date the user states that rate took effect. Null whenever usdToVndRate is.

note.description: The user's note, or the reason for a correction. Null when not given.
note.example: Cập nhật số dư sau khi đối chiếu sao kê.

correctsValuationId.description: The record this one corrects, when it is a correction. Null otherwise.

current.description: True on exactly one record of an asset: the one its current value, currency and valuation date are taken from. Latest effective date wins; between two on the same date, the later recorded.

recordedAt.description: When the server stored this record.

UpdateOnboardingRequest.description: Record progress through the guided onboarding. Send only what changed.

currentStep.description: The step the user is now viewing, 1 to 7 in the backbone order. The client resumes here next time.

dashboardReviewed.description: Whether the user has reviewed their first dashboard. true records the first review and keeps its moment if sent again; false withdraws it.

status.description: COMPLETED or DISMISSED ends the guided flow; IN_PROGRESS reopens it. Completion does not require every step to be done.

OnboardingResponse.description: The signed-in user's guided-onboarding checklist and where they are in it.

status.description: Where the user stands in the flow as a whole.

currentStep.description: The step the user last viewed, 1 to 7. 1 until the client records one.

steps.description: All seven steps, always in backbone order.

dashboardReviewedAt.description: When the user first reviewed their dashboard. Null until the client records it.

completedAt.description: When the user completed the flow. Null unless status is COMPLETED.

dismissedAt.description: When the user dismissed the flow. Null unless status is DISMISSED.

OnboardingStepState.description: One checklist step and whether it is done now.

key.description: Which step this is. The client maps it to its copy.

done.description: Whether the user's records satisfy this step right now. Deleting the last such record makes it false again.

GoalTemplateResponse.description: A goal template: a type and the suggested defaults for a new goal of that type.

type.description: The type a goal created from this template carries.

defaultExpectedAnnualReturnPercent.description: The suggested expected annual return, in percent. A suggestion, not a promise.

defaultHorizonMonths.description: How many months from today to suggest as the target date.

amountPrefill.description: Which amount the form should suggest, and from what figure the client already holds.

X-Correlation-Id.description: Correlation identifier. Send one matching ^[A-Za-z0-9-]{8,64}$ to have it echoed; anything else is replaced with a generated value and the request still succeeds. Always returned.

bearerAuth.description: The access token returned by /api/v1/auth/google or /api/v1/auth/refresh. Short-lived; renew with the refresh token rather than waiting for a 401.
